articles.title_en: Financing Competitors: Shadow Banks’ Funding and Mortgage Market Competition
articles.title_cn: 为竞争对手融资：影子银行的资金来源与抵押贷款市场竞争
articles.abstract_en: Using novel shadow bank funding data, I find that shadow banks are funded by the very banks they compete with when originating mortgages. Evidence suggests that banks have market power in the upstream market for shadow banks’ funding, which in turn softens mortgage market competition through their strategic behaviors in both markets. I build and calibrate a quantitative model of vertical integration and competition to show that those consumers who would most benefit from shadow bank services are the ones to bear the costs. Secondary market innovation could increase downstream competition by reducing shadow banks’ reliance on their competitors. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用新颖的影子银行融资数据，我发现影子银行在发放抵押贷款时，其资金来源正是它们所竞争的银行。证据表明，银行在影子银行融资的上游市场中拥有市场势力，这反过来通过它们在两个市场中的战略行为削弱了抵押贷款市场的竞争。我构建并校准了一个关于纵向一体化和竞争的定量模型，以表明那些最能从影子银行服务中受益的消费者恰恰是承担成本的人。二级市场创新可以通过减少影子银行对其竞争对手的依赖来增强下游竞争。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终发表论文的链接相邻处获取。

articles.title_en: Shocked by Bank Funding Shocks: Evidence from Consumer Credit Cards
articles.title_cn: 银行融资冲击的冲击：来自消费者信用卡的证据
articles.abstract_en: Using the near universe of U.S. consumer credit cards, we show that banks transmit their wholesale funding shocks to consumers by reducing their credit card limits. Credit-constrained consumers who are unable to hedge against the transmitted shock by accessing other credit cards experience a stronger and more persistent reduction in aggregate credit card limits at the consumer level. Consequently, these credit-constrained consumers reduce their aggregate credit card borrowing. Our results document a credit card lending channel for the transmission of adverse bank shocks and show who bears the costs of fragile bank funding structures. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用近乎全量的美国消费者信用卡数据，我们表明银行通过降低信用卡额度将批发融资冲击传导给消费者。受信贷约束的消费者若无法通过使用其他信用卡来对冲传导的冲击，其在消费者层面的总信用卡额度将经历更强烈且更持久的减少。因此，这些受信贷约束的消费者减少了总信用卡借款。我们的结果记录了信用卡贷款渠道在不利银行冲击传导中的作用，并揭示了谁承担了脆弱银行融资结构的成本。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终在线发表论文的链接相邻处获取。

articles.title_en: Liquidity Constraints, Consumption, and Debt Repayment: Evidence from Macroprudential Policy in Turkey
articles.title_cn: 流动性约束、消费与债务偿还：来自土耳其宏观审慎政策的证据
articles.abstract_en: Using account-level credit card data from a large Turkish bank, we study the impact of a unique credit card policy that increases minimum payment on consumption and debt repayment. We show that the policy reduces credit card spending and debt, boosts existing debt repayment, and reduces credit card delinquency. The credit card debt of affected consumers falls on average by 50$\%$ two years into the policy’s implementation. An increase in minimum payment has a stronger effect than does a decrease of a similar magnitude. We build a benchmark life cycle model with soft liquidity constraint to explain the reduction in credit card spending. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用一家大型土耳其银行的账户级信用卡数据，我们研究了一项独特的信用卡政策的影响，该政策提高了最低还款额，对消费和债务偿还产生影响。我们表明，该政策减少了信用卡支出和债务，促进了现有债务的偿还，并降低了信用卡违约率。受影响的消费者的信用卡债务在政策实施两年后平均下降了50。最低还款额的增加比同等幅度的减少具有更强的影响。我们构建了一个具有软流动性约束的基准生命周期模型来解释信用卡支出的减少。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终发表论文的链接相邻处获取。

articles.title_en: Adjusting to Macroprudential Policies: Loan-to-Value Limits and Housing Choice
articles.title_cn: 适应宏观审慎政策：贷款价值比限制与住房选择
articles.abstract_en: This study provides novel evidence regarding the effects of loan-to-value (LTV) limits on housing choices. Using a detailed loan-level dataset, I exploit the introduction of LTV limits in Israel. I find that the LTV limits led borrowers to choose housing units that were more affordable, farther from the central business district, and in lower socioeconomic neighborhoods. Additionally, these LTV limits increase interest rates and decrease loan amounts. The findings of this study indicate that macroprudential policies, which focus on the stability of the financial system, have micro implications on location choices, commuting costs, and movement to less-advantaged areas.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究提供了关于贷款价值比（LTV）限制对住房选择影响的新证据。利用详细的贷款级数据集，我利用了以色列引入LTV限制的机会。我发现LTV限制导致借款人选择更负担得起的住房单元，这些单元距离中央商务区更远，且位于社会经济地位较低的社区。此外，这些LTV限制提高了利率并减少了贷款金额。本研究的发现表明，关注金融体系稳定性的宏观审慎政策，对地点选择、通勤成本以及向弱势地区的迁移具有微观影响。

articles.title_en: Financial Crises and the Transmission of Monetary Policy to Consumer Credit Markets
articles.title_cn: 金融危机与货币政策向消费信贷市场的传导
articles.abstract_en: How does creditor health affect the pass-through of monetary policy to households? Using data on the universe of U.S. credit unions, I document that creditor asset losses increase the sensitivity of consumer credit to monetary policy. Identification exploits plausibly exogenous variation in asset losses and high-frequency identification of monetary policy shocks. Weaker lenders can respond more if they face financial frictions that easing alleviates. The estimates imply constraints on monetary policy become more costly in financial crises featuring creditor asset losses and that an additional benefit of monetary easing is that it weakens the causal, contractionary effect of asset losses. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online
articles.abstract_cn: 债权人健康状况如何影响货币政策向家庭的传导？利用美国信用合作社的总体数据，我记录了债权人资产损失增加了消费信贷对货币政策的敏感性。识别利用了资产损失的外生变异和货币政策冲击的高频识别。较弱的贷款人如果面临宽松政策缓解的金融摩擦，可能反应更大。估计表明，在债权人资产损失的金融危机中，货币政策的约束成本更高，而货币宽松的一个额外好处是削弱了资产损失的因果性紧缩效应。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终发表论文的链接相邻处获取。

articles.abstract_en: We study the stock market effects of the arrival of the three rounds of “stimulus checks” to U.S. taxpayers and the single round of direct payments to Hong Kong citizens. The first two rounds of U.S. checks appear to have increased retail buying and share prices of retail-dominated portfolios. The Hong Kong payments increased overall turnover and share prices on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. We cannot rule out that these price effects were permanent. The findings raise novel questions about the role of fiscal stimulus in the stock market. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了美国纳税人三轮“刺激支票”和香港市民单轮直接付款对股市的影响。美国前两轮支票似乎增加了散户购买和散户主导投资组合的股价。香港的付款增加了香港交易所的整体成交量和股价。我们不能排除这些价格影响是永久性的。这些发现引发了关于财政刺激在股市中作用的新问题。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终在线发表论文的链接旁边获取。

articles.title_en: Does the Federal Reserve Obtain Competitive and Appropriate Prices in Monetary Policy Implementation?
articles.title_cn: 美联储在货币政策实施中是否获得了竞争性和适当的价格？
articles.abstract_en: Many of the Federal Reserve’s (the Fed’s) monetary policy operations involve trading with primary dealers. We find that, for agency MBS, dealers charge 2.5 cents (per $100 face value) higher selling to the Fed than to non-Fed customers. Controlling for the same dealer, same security, and same trading time, this discriminatory pricing likely arises from dealers’ market power rather than inventory costs. Further, matching trade size reduces the price differential by more than half, implying that dealers’ market power greatly relates to the Fed’s purchases in large amounts, whereas the Fed’s limited breadth of counterparty choice also plays some role.
articles.abstract_cn: 美联储的许多货币政策操作涉及与一级交易商的交易。我们发现，对于机构抵押贷款支持证券，交易商向美联储出售的价格比向非美联储客户出售的价格高出2.5美分（每100美元面值）。在控制同一交易商、同一证券和同一交易时间的情况下，这种歧视性定价可能源于交易商的市场力量而非库存成本。此外，匹配交易规模使价格差异减少一半以上，这表明交易商的市场力量与美联储的大额购买密切相关，而美联储对手方选择范围有限也起了一定作用。

articles.title_en: When Do Low-Frequency Measures Really Measure Effective Spreads? Evidence from Equity and Foreign Exchange Markets
articles.title_cn: 低频度量何时真正衡量有效价差？来自股票和外汇市场的证据
articles.abstract_en: We present evidence that several popular low-frequency measures of effective spread suffer from a volatility-induced bias and that volatility is the primary driver of the variation of these liquidity proxies. Using data for U.S. equities and major foreign exchange rates, we show that the bias arises when the effective spread is small relative to volatility. We document that the bias has become more acute over time and show that volatility-biased measures fail to replicate some well-known results in empirical finance. We conclude by providing guidance on the choice of low-frequency measures in empirical applications. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供的证据表明，几种流行的有效价差低频度量存在波动性引起的偏差，且波动性是这些流动性代理变量变化的主要驱动因素。利用美国股票和主要外汇汇率的数据，我们表明当有效价差相对于波动性较小时，偏差就会出现。我们记录了偏差随时间变得更加严重，并表明波动性偏差的度量无法复制实证金融中一些众所周知的结果。最后，我们为实证应用中选择低频度量提供了指导。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终发表论文的在线链接旁边获取。

articles.title_en: International Portfolio Choice with Frictions: Evidence from Mutual Funds
articles.title_cn: 摩擦下的国际投资组合选择：来自共同基金的证据
articles.abstract_en: Using data on international equity portfolio allocations by U.S. mutual funds, we estimate a portfolio expression derived from a standard mean-variance portfolio model extended with portfolio frictions. The optimal portfolio depends on the previous month and the buy-and-hold portfolio shares, and a present discounted value of expected excess returns. We estimate expected return differentials and use them in the portfolio regressions. The estimates imply significant portfolio frictions and a modest rate of risk aversion. While mutual fund portfolios significantly respond to expected returns, portfolio frictions lead to a weaker and a more gradual portfolio response to changes in expected returns. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用美国共同基金的国际股票投资组合配置数据，我们估计了一个由标准均值-方差投资组合模型扩展而来的投资组合表达式，该模型包含了投资组合摩擦。最优投资组合取决于上个月和买入并持有的投资组合份额，以及预期超额收益的现值折现。我们估计预期收益差异，并将其用于投资组合回归中。估计结果显示出显著的投资组合摩擦和适度的风险厌恶率。虽然共同基金投资组合对预期收益有显著反应，但投资组合摩擦导致投资组合对预期收益变化的反应更弱且更渐进。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终在线发表论文的链接旁边获取。
